subject: API compatibility shim & customer exception coordination (compat header plan)
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: API compatibility shim & customer exception coordination (compat header plan)

Team —

Heads-up on an upcoming change that will require cross-functional coordination. Engineering plans to remove the implicit "token inheritance" behavior in our chat/completions endpoints as part of the v2.3 behavior cleanup. In short: certain system/prefix tokens that were previously auto-prepended and implicitly counted in session state will no longer be silently applied. That reduces surprising token billing but will change exact tokenization and response shape for some callers.

High-level timeline (tentative):
- Notice to internal orgs: Sep 20, 2026
- Customer-facing notice & start of compatibility shim window: Oct 4, 2026
- Soft-deprecation (no new enrollments in old behavior): Nov 18, 2026
- Hard cut (remove default old behavior): Jan 10, 2027

Engineering proposal (attached: impact_matrix_v2.xlsx): a per-tenant compatibility header (X-Compat-Mode: legacy) that preserves old behavior for up to 6 months after cut. This is intended as an operational shim, not a long-term guarantee; we should reserve the right to charge for extended support.

Action items I need from you:
- Marissa: a customer-facing notice draft and runbook for sales to use on renewals/expansions.
- Lauren: identify customers with regulatory constraints (Greenwave is one) and propose exception criteria/process.
- Rishi: confirm capacity and whether a per-tenant flag is feasible without incurring huge memory/latency penalties. Also provide an estimate for supporting 10-15 enterprise tenants in legacy mode concurrently.
- Aditya: coordinate comms cadence with docs and console teams so the Console deprecation banner and API docs align.

Attachments: impact_matrix_v2.xlsx, initial compatibility spec included inline.

We should treat Greenwave Health as a high-touch case — they currently have a HIPAA-adjacent deployment and historically require 90-day notice for behavior changes (per contract). If we need to make an exception window beyond the 6-month shim, we should surface that as a commercial ask.

Thanks —
Karthik
Product Lead, API Platform
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2026 13:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: API compatibility shim & customer exception coordination (compat header plan)

Karthik —

Thanks for laying this out. Two quick asks from Sales:
1) We need a short, non-technical customer notice by Sep 17 so AMs can start triage calls the week of Sep 20. The draft can be one page and should state impact, timelines, and next steps.
2) For Greenwave specifically, we should prepare a mutual action plan (MAP) that documents migration steps, acceptance criteria, and a visible rollback plan. If they require >90 days, we need a pricing/contract stance from Finance.

Can we get a short bullet list of expected migration work (client-side changes) so I can scope AM effort? Also, is there a recommended test harness (sample prompts) we can share?

I'll draft a notice and sync with Lauren for Greenwave details.

—Marissa
Account Exec, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 8 Sep 2026 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: API compatibility shim & customer exception coordination (compat header plan)

Marissa / Karthik —

Greenwave notes: they signed a services rider with a 90-day notification clause for behavioral changes to production APIs; procurement copied me on their internal escalation (procure@greenwavehealth.com). Their engineering lead, Sara Ayad, is worried about billing variance and EHR-integrations that assert exact token counts. They will need a compliance review window and a scheduled migration test with our sandbox.

Suggested approach for Greenwave:
- Offer the 6-month compat header by default.
- Provide a one-time, no-cost extension of 90 days past cut (total 9 months) for customers in good standing, subject to internal approval.
- For any extension beyond that, convert to paid premium support (T&M).
- Build a curated test suite for Greenwave that covers EHR prompt examples; include expected token deltas and sample prompts for clients to run.

I can collect a list of 10 customer-specific prompts from Greenwave this week. If Sales agrees, I’ll start the MAP template and request sandbox access for them.

—Lauren
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 8 Sep 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: API compatibility shim & customer exception coordination (compat header plan)

Quick engineering readout:
- Per-tenant compat header is feasible; implementation plan: a small routing flag checked at request ingress (cost: ~5% p95 latency hit for legacy path), we will keep legacy tokenization code behind a feature flag for ~6 months after cut.
- Memory/kv cache impact: legacy sessions will require preserving full prefill/kv behavior — estimate up to 12% increase in KV memory for tenants on legacy mode. That’s significant at scale; gating to 10-15 enterprise tenants makes sense.
- Canary: we can enable the legacy header for a small cohort (5 tenants) next month and validate metrics. After canary results, we can expand to the 10-15 enterprise list.

Needs from Product/Commercial:
- Final decision on whether to allow free extensions beyond 6 months (if yes, we need SRE budget to reserve memory and runway).
- A prioritized list of customers that must be supported in legacy mode (Greenwave at top).

I’ll attach a short runbook for how the ingress will mark/route legacy sessions (to be turned into a doc).

—Rishi
Engineering Manager, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

From: Sara Ayad <sara.ayad@greenwavehealth.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Sep 2026 08:01:00 -0700
Subject: RE: API compatibility shim & customer exception coordination (compat header plan)

Hi Lauren / Marissa / Karthik —

Thanks for the heads-up. Per our contract (section 7.1) we require 90 days notice for API behavior changes that affect production. We appreciate the compat header proposal — that helps — but we have an internal change control process that requires validation in a sandbox and a scheduled production cutover weekend. Can you confirm:

1) Will Greenwave get the 6-month compat header by default?
2) If we need more than 6 months, what is Redwood’s commercial policy?
3) Can Redwood provide a curated test pack and run a joint migration rehearsal in the sandbox?

Procurement copied as requested.

Warmly,
Sara Ayad
Lead Engineer, Integrations
Greenwave Health

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Sara Ayad <sara.ayad@greenwavehealth.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Sep 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: API compatibility shim & customer exception coordination (compat header plan)

Sara —

Appreciate the quick response and the contract pointer. Short answers:
1) Yes — Greenwave will receive the compatibility header by default at the start of the customer-facing window (Oct 4). That will preserve the legacy behavior for up to six months after our Jan 10, 2027 cut.
2) For extensions beyond six months we propose: a one-time, no-cost extension of an additional 90 days (so total 9 months) for customers with active support agreements in good standing. Any further extension beyond that will be treated as premium support (time & materials). Please note this is a commercial exception request — final approval subject to Revenue/Finance sign-off.
3) We will provide a curated test pack and can schedule a joint migration rehearsal in the sandbox. Lauren will coordinate sandbox credentials and a rehearsal window.

Action items (owners & deadlines):
- Marissa: customer notice draft for Sep 17 (owner: Marissa).
- Lauren: MAP template + sandbox coordination (owner: Lauren).
- Rishi: enable canary for 5 tenants in Oct and provide capacity estimate for up to 15 (owner: Rishi).
- Aditya: align Console docs and banner by Oct 4 (owner: Aditya).
- Karthik: surface commercial exception for Greenwave to Finance, request one-time 90-day no-cost extension (by Sep 15).

I’ll attach the current draft notice and the impact matrix to the HubSpot deal (see link). If Finance approves the one-time extension, we’ll send an official MAP and lock in rehearsal dates.

Thanks everyone —
Karthik
Product Lead, API Platform
Redwood Inference
